name: FJPG-18
summary: A Flexmo compliant robot joint module in HAMOOBot’s Star series. The module combines an elastic output structure with geared actuation and dual absolute-encoder feedback. Its stated rated torque is 6 N·m, peak torque 18 N·m and mass 0.8 kg.
